BiblicalUsage: Genubath is a person named once in Scripture, in 1 Kings. No People profile carries this name, so I note the name’s use here and go no further.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Genubath in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
